## The problem you have

You are about to commit to a completion programme. The basis of design
is written, the AFE is drafted, the equipment is on order. Internally,
everyone has signed off — but the people who signed off are the same
people who wrote it. You need an outside reviewer who has actually
delivered HPHT, deepwater, or sour-service wells, before the rig hits
the well.

## What you get

Three tiers, depending on how much scrutiny you need:

| Tier | Deliverable | Turnaround | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Quick Look** | 60-minute scoping call + 1-page red-flag note covering 3–5 highest-risk issues | 5 working days | **£950** |
| **Programme Review** | Full document review (BoD, well programme, risk register, materials selection) + 5-page memo with prioritised findings + 60-minute readout call | 10 working days | **£2,950** |
| **Deep Dive** | Programme Review plus 1-day on-site / remote workshop with the well team, structured well-on-paper facilitation, post-workshop report | 30 days end-to-end | **£8,500 – £14,500** |

: {tbl-colwidths="[18,46,16,20]"}

The Programme Review tier is the most common entry point.

## What this is not

- A liability transfer. The well operator remains the duty-holder; my
  review is advisory.
- An equipment audit. I review design and operational thinking, not
  vendor certifications.
- A replacement for your internal HSE risk assessment.

## Process

1. **30-min discovery call** — you explain the well, the timeline, what
   you need an independent opinion on. I tell you which tier fits.
2. **One-page proposal** — fixed price, fixed scope, fixed deliverable.
   Signed within 24 hours.
3. **Delivery on the agreed turnaround.** You receive a clean memo or
   report; we run the readout call; you decide what to act on.

## Frequently asked

**Can you sign an NDA?**
Yes. Standard mutual NDA available, or I will sign yours after a quick
legal scan.

**Do you have professional indemnity insurance?**
Yes. £1M cover via Mattey Energy Ltd.

**Will you take work that conflicts with your day role?**
No. I keep a strict conflict-of-interest framework and decline anything
that touches Basra Energy Company Limited's operational footprint or
BP / CNPC JV interests.

**Who owns the deliverable?**
You do, on full payment. I retain the right to publish the *methodology*
in anonymised form (no client name, no well name, no figures); the
underlying documents and any client-specific findings remain confidential.

**What happens if I cancel?**
Quick Look: 50% refund if cancelled before the call. Programme Review:
50% refund before document handover, 0% after. Deep Dive: pro-rated by
hours delivered.
